not_in_requirements_lock.reason: The lock is a pip freeze of the environment the CWAD runs used, and neither kernel appears in it: that box has no flash-attn build and no nvcc to compile one, so attention ran with attn_implementation=sdpa (CWAD_ATTN_IMPLEMENTATION in config/best.env). scripts/prepare_env.sh installs both unless --skip-kernels is passed, so they are optional additions on top of the lock, not part of it.
